learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: recognize and preserve the responsible loader's truck/case order, labels, destination and orientation cues; move or stage cases as directed and report mismatches instead of improvising a new pack sequence.
notes: Ordinary support workflow only. Public-road cargo acceptance, load-distribution design, regulated driving and powered loading equipment remain external.

learner_facing_text: Truck-pack/case-orientation support does not authorize public-road cargo acceptance, regulated driving, load-distribution engineering, powered-equipment operation or independent securement decisions.
notes: Routes regulated responsibility to GATE-DRIVER/CARGO where applicable.

learner_facing_text: Planned Field Skill: recognize common connector families at a basic vocabulary level, understand that visual similarity does not establish identical function or compatibility, use labels/current department direction, and stop/ask rather than forcing an unfamiliar or non-seating connector.
notes: Recognition and escalation only; exact retained connector facts should later use manufacturer/official documentation.

learner_facing_text: Connector recognition does not authorize energized-power work, temporary-power connection, patch changes, system configuration, troubleshooting, specialty testing or any work reserved for a qualified/assigned technician.
notes: Electrical authority routes through GATE-ELC-TRAINING/AUTH; other technical authority remains department/employer controlled.
